rule.description: UserAccount entitlement: do not match existing accounts
rule.comment: When using the User Account entitlement with the Identity Manager user application or Role Based Entitlements, accounts are created and deleted/disabled by granting or revoking the entitlement. Default policy does not match an existing account in Office365 if the user is not entitled to an account in Office365. Modify or remove this rule if you want entitlement policy to apply to allow match for accounts in Office365. Notice that this may result in the Office365 account being deleted or disabled.
